Through our subgranted projects several policies have been revised as described belowFederation of Liberian Youth After deploying a Youth Election Observation situation room the African Union invited FLY to join its African Union Elections Observation Mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo in December of 2023. Blind Youth Association Nepal BYAN On 26 January 2024 partial elections to the National Assembly were held to allocate 19 vacant seats. Prior to the filing of candidacy by the political parties BYAN team visited each political partys offices in collaboration with another CSO. Both organisations submitted their statement and demand paper to the political leaders. As a result of their lobbying and advocacy works a total of seven candidates were PwD. Accountability Labs Nepal In January 2024 the government representatives of Nepalgunj SubMetropolitan City Nepal decided to impose a new fine for the public and businesses that dont comply with waste management standards.

Through our subgranted projects several policies have been revised as described belowFederation of Liberian Youth After deploying a Youth Election Observation situation room the African Union invited FLY to join its African Union Elections Observation Mission in the Democratic Republic of Congo in December of 2023. Blind Youth Association Nepal BYAN On 26 January 2024 partial elections to the National Assembly were held to allocate 19 vacant seats. Prior to the filing of candidacy by the political parties BYAN team visited each political partys offices in collaboration with another CSO. Both organisations submitted their statement and demand paper to the political leaders. As a result of their lobbying and advocacy works a total of seven candidates were PwD. Accountability Labs Nepal In January 2024 the government representatives of Nepalgunj SubMetropolitan City Nepal decided to impose a new fine for the public and businesses that dont comply with waste management standards.

The customary forums held so far have included chiefs forums chiefs conferences and workshops for court clerks.At the chiefs conferences topics discussed included community awareness of customary courts linking courts and working together case referrals case management and representation of women in courts. The conferences enabled consolidation of findings from customary justice forums in each project site and the promotion of knowledge sharing and understanding among chiefs and court staff.The clerks workshops led to the creation of a network of clerks in Juba many had not met before the sharing of challenges and development of solutions sharing of good practice and the development of case management systems for each court. There is no reporting on any number of issues discussed since the establishment of the baseline however
